format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body:
<sf-progress-run id="run" label="Создание сайта demo.test" cancelable retryable hideable output-open><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"steps": [{"id": "dns", "title": "Адрес demo.test", "state": "done", "duration": 1200}, {"id": "files", "title": "Файлы сайта", "state": "done", "duration": 5300, "text": "120 файлов"}, {"id": "db", "title": "База данных", "state": "running", "text": "Создаём таблицы"}, {"id": "ssl", "title": "Сертификат", "state": "waiting"}], "output": "$ create-site demo.test
DNS: ok
Copying 120 files... ok
Creating tables...
"}</script></sf-progress-run>

<sf-progress-run id="failed" label="Импорт" retryable hideable run-state="failed" result-text="Файл повреждён"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"steps": [{"id": "dns", "title": "Адрес demo.test", "state": "done", "duration": 1200}, {"id": "files", "title": "Файлы сайта", "state": "failed", "duration": 64000, "text": "Не хватает места на диске"}, {"id": "db", "title": "База данных", "state": "skipped"}]}</script></sf-progress-run>

<sf-progress-run id="imp" label="Импорт товаров" caption="Каталог «Электроника»" value="4812" total="12000" unit="товар|товара|товаров" remaining="360000" pausable cancelable minimizable><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"counters": [{"id": "added", "label": "Добавлено", "value": 3700}, {"id": "updated", "label": "Обновлено", "value": 1100}, {"id": "skipped", "label": "Пропущено", "value": 0}, {"id": "errors", "label": "{n} ошибка|{n} ошибки|{n} ошибок", "value": 12, "status": "error"}], "steps": [{"id": "read", "title": "Чтение файла", "state": "done", "duration": 4000}, {"id": "rows", "title": "Товары", "state": "running", "value": 4812, "total": 12000, "unit": "товар|товара|товаров"}]}</script></sf-progress-run>

<sf-progress-run id="sum" label="Импорт" heading-level="2" value="12000" total="12000" errors-total="40" retryable hideable><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"counters": [{"id": "added", "label": "Добавлено", "value": 9214}, {"id": "errors", "label": "{n} ошибка|{n} ошибки|{n} ошибок", "value": 40, "status": "error"}], "errors": [{"where": "218", "key": "TV-55-QL", "text": "Цена — не число"}, {"where": "1 042", "key": "SM-A55", "text": "Раздел не найден"}, {"where": "3 377", "key": "—", "text": "Пустой артикул"}, {"where": "5 610", "key": "HD-2TB", "text": "Картинка 404"}, {"where": "8 905", "key": "KB-MX", "text": "Артикул повторяется"}, {"where": "9 120", "key": "PH-X1", "text": "Шестая"}], "steps": [{"id": "read", "title": "Чтение", "state": "done", "duration": 4000}, {"id": "rows", "title": "Товары", "state": "done", "duration": 9000}]}</script></sf-progress-run>
<sf-progress-run id="cnl" label="Экспорт" run-state="cancelled" value="1200" total="4000" retryable></sf-progress-run>

<sf-progress-run id="lg" label="Резервная копия docs" retryable><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"steps": [{"id": "db", "title": "База данных", "state": "done", "duration": 42000, "log": "db ok\n"}, {"id": "up", "title": "Выгрузка", "state": "failed", "duration": 160000, "log": "QuotaExceeded\n"}]}</script></sf-progress-run>
<sf-progress-run id="cmp" look="compact" label="Копия shop" value="62" total="100" remaining="180000" pausable cancelable></sf-progress-run>
<sf-progress-run id="ntc" look="notice" label="Копия blog" value="62" total="100" remaining="180000"></sf-progress-run>

probes.title: the steps are an ordered list with their states and times; the running one is aria-current; the run is running, its region named by label
probes.covers: settings.steps, settings.label, settings.run-state auto, host-states data-state, accessibility.role region

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); const root = el.querySelector('section.sf-progress-run'); const steps = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-step')]; return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'running' && document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent === 'Создание сайта demo.test' && steps.map((s) => s.dataset.state).join(',') === 'done,done,running,waiting' && steps[2].getAttribute('aria-current') === 'step' && steps[0].querySelector('.sf-progress-run-time').textContent === '0:01' && steps[1].querySelector('.sf-progress-run-time').textContent === '0:05' && steps[0].querySelector('.sr-only').textContent === ', готово' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-cancel') && !el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-retry') && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result').textContent.trim() === ''; })()

probes.title: Cancel asks sf-progress-run-cancel; the run changes nothing by itself

steps.check: document.querySelector('#run').getAttribute('data-state') === 'running'

probes.title: chunk appends to the output; the pane follows the end while the reader is there, and keeps a reader who scrolled up

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); let lines = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 60; i += 1) lines += `line ${i}\n`; return el.chunk({text: lines}).outcome === 'applied'; })()
steps.check: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('#run .sf-progress-run-output'); return pane.getAttribute('role') === 'log' && pane.querySelector('pre').textContent.includes('line 59') && pane.scrollHeight - pane.scrollTop - pane.clientHeight < 2; })()

steps.script: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('#run .sf-progress-run-output'); pane.scrollTop = 0; document.querySelector('#run').chunk({text: 'more\n'}); return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('#run .sf-progress-run-output'); return pane.scrollTop === 0 && pane.querySelector('pre').textContent.endsWith('more\n'); })()
true

probes.title: step changes one step; when the last is done the run is done, the result line says «Готово» in its status region and Hide shows

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); el.step({id: 'db', state: 'done', duration: 2000}); el.step({id: 'ssl', state: 'done', duration: 900}); return el.step({id: 'nope', state: 'done'}).outcome === 'refused'; })()
steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#run'); const result = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'done' && result.getAttribute('role') === 'status' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result-text').textContent === 'Готово' && !el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-cancel') && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-hide'); })()

probes.title: a failed run says the host's reason and offers Retry, which sends sf-progress-run-retry

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#failed'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'failed' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result-text').textContent === 'Файл повреждён' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-icon--failed'); })()

probes.title: the output toggle opens and closes the pane with aria-expanded; download is a cancelable request

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#failed'); const toggle = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-toggle button'); return el.outputOpen === true && toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-output'); })()

probes.title: the overall bar is determinate at the percentage; the figures read «N из M товаров · %» in tabular figures; the counts are one line, zero ones left out, only the non-zero error count a link (C34)

steps.check: (() => { const n = (s) => s.replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim(); const el = document.querySelector('#imp'); const bar = el.querySelector('sf-progress-bar.sf-progress-run-bar'); const fig = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-done'); const counts = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-count')].map((c) => n(c.textContent)); const link = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-count--error a.sf-progress-run-count-link'); return bar.getAttribute('value') === '40' && !bar.hasAttribute('indeterminate') && n(fig.textContent) === '4 812 из 12 000 товаров · 40 %' && getComputedStyle(fig.parentElement).fontVariantNumeric === 'tabular-nums' && counts.join('|') === 'Добавлено 3 700|Обновлено 1 100|12 ошибок' && link && n(link.textContent) === '12 ошибок' && el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-counts a').length === 1; })()

probes.title: the host's remaining is rounded up in words: 360000 ms reads «осталось ≈ 6 мин»; the figures are not live (C34)

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#imp'); const eta = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-eta'); return eta && eta.textContent.trim() === 'осталось ≈ 6 мин' && !eta.closest('[aria-live="polite"],[role="status"]'); })()

probes.title: Pause asks pause; paused (warning badge and bar, the bar says paused) shows Continue, which asks resume; the status region says the state change only

steps.check: document.querySelector('#imp').getAttribute('data-state') === 'running'

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#imp'); const bar = el.querySelector('sf-progress-bar.sf-progress-run-bar'); const badge = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-head sf-badge'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'paused' && badge.getAttribute('activity') === 'paused' && bar.hasAttribute('paused') && bar.getAttribute('status') === 'warning' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result[role="status"]').textContent.trim() === 'Пауза' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-resume') && !el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-pause'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#imp'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'running' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result[role="status"]').textContent.trim() === 'Продолжается' && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-pause'); })()

probes.title: finished with errors is partial: a warning badge «С ошибками» and a warning bar, never success; the first 5 errors, «Ещё 35 ошибок» and the error link ask report; Retry asks only what failed; the title is an h2 at heading-level 2
probes.covers: settings.run-state auto→partial, settings.errors, settings.errors-total, events.report, events.retry scope failed, settings.heading-level

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#sum'); const badge = el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-head sf-badge'); const bar = el.querySelector('sf-progress-bar.sf-progress-run-bar'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'partial' && badge.getAttribute('status') === 'warning' && badge.getAttribute('icon-start') === 'warning' && badge.getAttribute('text') === 'С ошибками' && !badge.hasAttribute('activity') && bar.getAttribute('status') === 'warning' && el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-error').length === 5 && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-more').getAttribute('text') === 'Ещё 35 ошибок' && el.querySelector('h2.sf-progress-run-heading') && el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-result-text').textContent.trim() === 'Готово с ошибками'; })()
document.activeElement === document.querySelector('#sum .sf-progress-run-errors')

probes.title: cancelled is neutral: the bar's neutral status (no grey status exists) and the stopped badge «Отменено»; Retry asks all

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#cnl'); const badge = el.querySelector('sf-badge'); const bar = el.querySelector('sf-progress-bar.sf-progress-run-bar'); return el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'cancelled' && badge.getAttribute('activity') === 'stopped' && badge.getAttribute('text') === 'Отменено' && bar.getAttribute('status') === 'neutral'; })()

probes.title: without total the bar runs (indeterminate, no value said) and the run counts its elapsed time

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#ind'); const bar = el.querySelector('sf-progress-bar.sf-progress-run-bar'); const inner = bar.querySelector('.sf-progress-bar'); return bar.hasAttribute('indeterminate') && inner && !inner.hasAttribute('aria-valuenow') && /^\d+:\d\d$/u.test(el.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-eta').textContent.trim()); })()

probes.title: a step with a log is a toggle over it; a failed step's log is open by itself; chunk({text, step}) appends to that step's log, an unknown step is refused; Retry asks from the failed step
probes.covers: actions.chunk step, settings.steps log, events.retry from

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#lg'); const [db, up] = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-progress-run-step-toggle')]; return db.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && up.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && document.getElementById(up.getAttribute('aria-controls')).textContent.includes('QuotaExceeded') && el.getAttribute('data-state') === 'failed'; })()

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#lg'); return el.chunk({text: 'retrying later\n', step: 'up'}).outcome === 'applied' && el.chunk({text: 'x', step: 'nope'}).reason === 'missing'; })()
steps.check: document.querySelector('#lg .sf-progress-run-step-log').textContent.endsWith('retrying later\n')
document.querySelector('#lg .sf-progress-run-step-toggle').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true'

probes.title: view compact is one line: the bar with «62 % · 3 мин» and icon actions; view notice: the ring in the icon field, the name, the figures and Expand, which asks expand

steps.check: (() => { const n = (s) => s.replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim(); const c = document.querySelector('#cmp'); const t = document.querySelector('#ntc'); return c.querySelector('.sf-progress-run--view-compact[role="group"]') && c.querySelector('sf-progress-bar') && n(c.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-figures-short').textContent) === '62 % · 3 мин' && c.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-pause') && c.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-cancel') && t.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-mark sf-progress-ring') && n(t.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-notice-figures').textContent) === '62 % · осталось ≈ 3 мин' && t.querySelector('.sf-progress-run-expand'); })()
